updates.candidate_contract_note: Analytical audit description correction only: Uniform first-eligible-panel initialization/aria-hidden synchronization across all four heterogeneous component owners. The literal composite was never implemented or declared by the baseline owner. No accepted SITE-U01/U02/BUILD-G01 task advertises this additional feature. The analytical summary overstates the actual owner contract; correcting it does not retire supported concrete behavior. Actual supported owner contract: DecisionEvidence selects first case; ContextExplorer validates and honors declared initial/default overlap; ExampleChoices selects0 only with matched panes/buttons; AcademyOverview synchronizes existing details disclosures. No common first-panel protocol exists across this family.

The literal composite was never implemented or declared by the baseline owner. No accepted SITE-U01/U02/BUILD-G01 task advertises this additional feature. The analytical summary overstates the actual owner contract; correcting it does not retire supported concrete behavior. Actual supported owner contract: ExampleChoices deliberately uses a labelled role=group of aria-pressed buttons, native Tab/Enter and extra Arrow/Home/End focus/selection.
